title: Alleviating Limited Effectiveness and Multi-Class Collapse in Deep Graph-level Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2611.06052v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Given a collection of $N$ graphs, graph-level clustering (GLC) seeks to partition the $N$ graphs into semantically meaningful groups, which serves as a fundamental task in analyzing graph-structured data. While Graph Isomorphism Networks (GINs) have become the de facto encoders for GLC, they still fail to distinguish graphs due to their neglect of global topology. On top of that, existing deep clustering frameworks suffer from severe "clustering collapse" issues, particularly in imbalanced multi-class scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose S$^3$GLC, a novel framework that integrates global topological characteristics with local neighborhood features for balanced GLC. Theoretically, we leverage the Hoffman-Wielandt inequality to construct Spectral Signature as a rigorous lower bound for graph edit distance (GED), providing a computationally efficient proxy for global topological features. translated_abstract: 给定一个包含N个图的集合，图级聚类（GLC）旨在将这些图划分为语义上有意义的群组，这是分析图结构数据的一项基础任务。尽管图同构网络（GIN）已成为GLC事实上的标准编码器，但由于忽视全局拓扑结构，它们仍无法有效区分不同的图。此外，现有的深度聚类框架存在严重的“聚类坍塌”问题，在不平衡的多类别场景中尤为突出。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了S³GLC，这是一个将全局拓扑特征与局部邻域特征相融合、以实现平衡图级聚类的新颖框架。在理论上，我们利用Hoffman-Wielandt不等式构建了谱签名，作为图编辑距离（GED）的严格下界，从而为全局拓扑特征提供了计算高效的代理。此外，我们还提出了一个联合流形……（摘要内容不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出S³GLC框架，利用Hoffman-Wielandt不等式构建谱签名作为图编辑距离的高效下界代理，将全局拓扑特征与局部邻域特征相融合，从而缓解深度图级聚类中区分能力不足和多类别聚类坍塌的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes S³GLC, a novel framework that leverages the Hoffman-Wielandt inequality to construct a Spectral Signature as an efficient lower-bound proxy for graph edit distance, integrating global topological features with local neighborhood features to alleviate limited effectiveness and multi-class collapse in deep graph-level clustering.
